Third-party license notice: cividis color map
=============================================

DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.VegaLite contains the color values of the cividis color
map ("cividis"), which was designed by Jamie R. Nunez, Christopher R. Anderton
and Ryan S. Renslow (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory) and is published by
Vega (https://github.com/vega/vega) as samples of the polynomial approximation
that d3-scale-chromatic (https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic) uses.

The cividis color map is distributed under the license of the cmaputil
repository of the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory
(https://github.com/pnnl/cmaputil), a permissive license of the BSD kind that
requires the notice, the conditions and the disclaimer below to be reproduced in
binary distributions. The text below is reproduced exactly as published in the
LICENSE file of that repository.

This project is not affiliated with, and is not endorsed or promoted by,
Battelle Memorial Institute or the authors of the cividis color map.
